title: MHDash: An Online Platform for Benchmarking Mental Health–Aware AI Assistants
reasoning: The paper focuses on the clinical and safety-critical aspects of mental health assessment, specifically risk classification for suicidal ideation and self-harm. While it includes a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section regarding data privacy and the limitations of AI in clinical diagnosis, it does not evaluate or benchmark models on religious, theological, or moral/ethical reasoning.
